## Specific task description

Task instruction: Position the ceramic drinking cup with floral design at the center of the smooth round plate for serving.

Task description: Place the ceramic drinking cup with blue patterns on the left side of the table at the center of the smooth light-colored round plate toward the front right.

Success criteria: Place the cup near the center of the round plate, close to and supported by its surface; it must not remain suspended above the plate. Both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- With the cup open, consider a section near the upper wall with sufficient inside and outside clearance. Put one finger inside and one outside, with pads contacting the wall below the rim. Adjust the opening for local wall thickness and fingertip clearance to reduce collisions from grasping across the whole cup.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on the inner and outer sides of the cup wall rather than only pressing against the rim. A slight lift can reveal slipping or tilt; adjust the grasp if needed.
- Keep the cup opening facing up during transport and its base high enough to clear the plate rim, avoiding contact that could tip the cup.
- Lower the cup slowly near the plate and release only after the cup bottom is securely supported. When withdrawing, watch the inner finger’s clearance from the cup opening to avoid tipping the cup.
